# Egress allow-list for the code review bot's agent job.
#
# The review job of lfreleng-actions/github-code-review-bot runs a
# read-only agent on a pull request, in both the approve and the
# antagonistic mode. This list is what that one job may reach under
# 'egress-policy: block'. The bot's other jobs keep the organisation
# list (../lfreleng-actions/allow_list.txt).
#
# The session can only read: its shell is limited to a few read-only
# utilities. So the job needs GitHub, the npm registry for the pinned
# Copilot CLI, and the model. Do not add hosts for a target
# repository's toolchain here.
#
# Evidence: harden-runner audit records of 344 agent sessions,
# 6 October to 15 November 2026. Every one reached these hosts and no
# other.
#
# Load it by explicit path with harden-runner-block-action:
#
#   - uses: lfreleng-actions/harden-runner-block-action@<sha>  # <version>
#     with:
#       config: 'lfreleng-actions//.github/harden-runner/bots/code_review.txt@<.github commit sha>'
#
# This file is not named 'allow_list.txt' on purpose; see
# ../README.md for why a second file of that name breaks forks.
#
# Format: one host[:port] entry per line, sorted alphabetically
# (LC_ALL=C), with a '# comment' directly above each entry.

# GitHub hosted-runner control plane (hosted-compute orchestrator and
# watchdog), reached by the runner itself after the job's steps.
*.githubapp.com:443

# Copilot model API and the CLI's telemetry. The host differs by
# credential: api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com and
# telemetry.enterprise.githubcopilot.com for a personal token,
# api.githubcopilot.com for the job's own token.
*.githubcopilot.com:443

# GitHub REST API, reached by the Copilot CLI itself.
api.github.com:443

# Copilot CLI metrics endpoint.
cafe.github.com:443

# GitHub over HTTPS: checkout of the prompt assets and the pull
# request head.
github.com:443

# npm registry: the job installs the pinned Copilot CLI from its
# lockfile.
registry.npmjs.org:443
